titulo: What if everyone got a million dollars? 💸 #shorts  #animation #science #whatif #nyumi
descripcion:
If everyone on Earth got a million dollars… nobody would be rich. 🤯
Nyx wants to buy all the bread. Lumi tests it in Test Town, and Bob the baker has other plans.

Sources: IMF World Economic Outlook (world GDP 2025), Weimar hyperinflation 1923, Zimbabwe hyperinflation 2008 (Steve Hanke, Johns Hopkins)
